# Image credits

All images in this folder are served locally from `/images/…` (nothing is hotlinked).
They were downloaded from Wikimedia Commons, resized to web sizes (hero 1600 px wide,
gallery 960 px wide) and re-compressed as JPEG. No other edits were made. Each image
remains under its original licence; the CC BY / CC BY-SA licences require the attribution
below to be kept when the site is published.

## Adding or replacing an image

When you swap an image, add or update its row above (file name, author, source URL and
licence). If you use a self-made or generated image, write `placeholder` in the Source
column. See "Swapping images" in the project `README.md`.
